claims: Crimson Desert launches worldwide on March 19, 2026, for PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S.
Crimson Desert focuses on a single-player, open-world action-adventure experience following the character Macduff.
Preloading for Crimson Desert is available 48 hours before the release.
Preloading for Crimson Desert begins on March 17, 2026.
Crimson Desert's release time is 3:00 PM PT.
Crimson Desert's release time is 6:00 PM ET.
Crimson Desert's release time is 10:00 PM GMT.
Crimson Desert has no post-launch microtransactions.
Crimson Desert includes 4K resolution on supported consoles.
Crimson Desert includes 60+ fps on supported consoles.
Crimson Desert includes ray tracing on supported consoles.
